newsitem.title: USA: Netscape in browser pact with 5 Regional Bell companies.
newsitem.headline: Netscape in browser pact with 5 Regional Bell companies.

text.p: Netscape Communications Corp. and five regional Bell phone companies said Tuesday they agreed to a marketing pact making Netscape Navigator the main browser for their Internet service business.
Participating in the deal with Netscape were the Internet service provision units of Ameritech Corp., Bell Atlantic Corp., BellSouth Corp., Pacific Telesis Group and SBC Communications Inc.
The pact includes a feature to simplify how computer users select an Internet Service Provider.

Users running Netscape Navigator software would be able to contact their telephone company's Internet Service Provider through the new Netscape ISP Select feature on its Navigator browser software, they said.

Netscape said the ISP Select service will allow people to set up a personal Internet account and establish an Internet connection easily and quickly. In addition, phone company customers would have free access to information available via the Netscape In-Box Direct service, the companies said.
Netscape In-Box is a service recently introduced by Netscape to provide information from 40 selected content providers.
Together, the five Bell companies represent a potential market of 72 million consumers and businesses in 26 states, including Washington, D.C., and in 15 of the nation's 20 largest markets.
The companies said the ISP Select feature will make it easy for customers to select the five regional Bell Internet companies for Internet access services.

They said future plans include offering the ability for ISP Select users who choose their local telephone company's Internet access service to have their Internet fees billed directly to their phone bills.

ISP Select will be accessible through a section of Netscape's Internet site that will take users through the necessary steps for easily creating an account, selecting an ISP or choosing a different ISP.
After users enter their area code and phone number, they will be presented with a list of service providers with coverage in their particular area.
